recreation_prompt_markdown:
Recreate a mobile-first portrait browser game called `Mjolnir Shieldline: Orbital Arena`. Preserve the mechanics of a left-side drag-to-aim defense shooter: the player aims a fixed super-soldier rail cannon by dragging/touching, releases to fire cooldown-governed projectiles, destroys right-to-left incoming enemies, protects a shield gate, earns requisition score/currency, survives escalating sectors, buys/equips loadouts, and optionally selects threat modifiers for score multipliers.

The public-facing identity should feel like a Halo-inspired sci-fi arena shooter without using licensed assets: green armored super-soldier focal silhouette, gold visor, clean cyan military-futurist HUD, orbital ring arena background, alien purple/teal/red warforms, plasma/rail shots, shield pips, heroic orchestral/action audio cues from approved catalogs, and compact touch-friendly menus. Keep the implementation self-contained in `index.html` using Canvas, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source is a single-screen canvas defense shooter. A fixed left-side firing rig aims by mouse/touch drag and fires on release. Projectiles travel across the arena, can arc under gravity, home, or latch depending on equipped loadout, and collide with rectangular incoming targets. Incoming targets spawn from the right, move left, may have HP, speed, size, special motion, and score values, and damage a shield wall when they cross the left barrier. The player fails when shield HP reaches zero. Waves increase enemy count, speed, and enemy type variety. Score becomes persistent currency for loadout purchases, and optional modifiers alter risk/reward.

## Protected mechanics
- Drag/touch aim from a fixed left-side actor and release-to-fire.
- Cooldown-based firing with loadout-specific shot count, damage, speed, spread, homing, and latch flags.
- Weighted right-side enemy spawning and wave gates.
- Projectile point-in-rectangle collision, HP reduction, knockback on nonlethal hits, TNT area explosion, and shield-wall breach failure.
- Score values, modifier multipliers, wave-clear bonus, currency persistence, shop/equip flow, and restart/menu state flow.

## Remixed target
`Mjolnir Shieldline: Orbital Arena` reframes the protected defense shooter as a portrait-first Halo-inspired sci-fi arena firefight. The player is a green-armored super-soldier turret defending an orbital shield gate against alien pods and vehicle silhouettes. The old sky/cargo look is replaced by an animated orbital ring arena, clean military HUD, plasma/rail projectiles, shield pips, requisition economy, threat operations, alien intel, and prototype loadouts.

## Safe transformation surfaces
Entity silhouettes, canvas drawing, color palette, text, HUD language, modal layout, background, particles, audio naming, shop copy, and progression labels are presentation-facing and have been transformed while retaining mechanic values and state semantics.
